clips.caption:
Deepak Chopra's own son made a documentary that painted his father as a terrible person.

When an interviewer asked Deepak about it, his answer stopped Kevin Trudeau cold: "My son didn't do a documentary about me. My son did a documentary about himself."

That's the whole truth about the toxic people in your life - the ones who irritate you are showing you yourself, not the other way around. Every time you point a finger, three more point back at you.

Stop trying to fix the other person. Fix what's inside you, and the relationship changes on its own.

Who in your life might really be a mirror?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #selfimprovement #relationships #innerwork #personalgrowth

Kevin Trudeau warned his girlfriend Christy before meeting his mom: brace yourself, she's nuts, she's controlling.

Christy spent the whole dinner laughing with her instead. Kevin got bored and left to watch sports with his uncle - and when he asked how Christy survived it, she said she'd had more fun than she'd had in months.

Same mother. Same personality. One person braced for a nightmare and got a wonderful night.

The person you're dreading usually isn't the problem. Your own expectation is.

Who have you already decided is "difficult" before giving them a real chance?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #relationships #selfawareness #perspective #personalgrowth
